requirements.title: Input/output statements require units with the properties needed for execution
requirements.definition: If a unit, or a file connected to a unit, lacks all properties required for certain I/O statements, those statements shall not refer to that unit.

pending.io-statement-unit-must-have-required-pro: Positive control opens a scratch external formatted sequential unit with the needed action and form before executing a matching formatted WRITE; source-control negatives use mismatched unit properties but claim no required diagnostic for this unnumbered restriction alone.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first (for example by writing known records, initializing variables to nonzero/nonblank sentinels, or creating a known file) and then observe only portable properties: exact internal records, successful IOSTAT zero, nonzero IOSTAT for a specified error condition, named intrinsic status values where the standard names them, branch-target execution, or unchanged sentinel values where the source requires no definition. Processor-dependent unit numbers, file names, record lengths, storage-unit encodings, buffering, timing, IOMSG text, and specific nonzero IOSTAT numbers are not asserted.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Negative plans are source-control plans unless this unit itself requires rejection and a future fixture can observe the rejection portably. IOMSG wording, processor-dependent numeric status values, undefined values, indeterminate file positions, and recursive I/O program restrictions without a required diagnostic are never treated as exact oracles.

accounting.rationale: Recursive external-unit prohibition and child data transfer exception are split.
Explicit child data transfer permission for the parent external unit.
Recursive internal-unit prohibition and recursive WRITE exception are split.
Recursive modification prohibition for internal units.
Explicit permission for a recursive WRITE to modify its own internal unit.
Specifier-to-specifier dependency and control-to-input dependency restrictions are split.
Internal-file/FMT/ID/IOMSG/IOSTAT/SIZE independence from input items and implied-do variables.
Specifier variable subscript and substring-bound independence restriction.
Array-element subscript stability restriction for status/message/size variables.
NOTE only cross-references expression side-effect restrictions and is not normative.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.10.3-12.12: IOLENGTH, error, end-of-record and end-of-file conditions, IOSTAT=, IOMSG=, and restrictions on I/O statements (batch166). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer, accepted with no findings. IOLENGTH's exact count is latitude but its direct-access RECL= suitability is planned; END=/EOR= conditions, IOSTAT_END and IOSTAT_EOR distinctness, zero on success and positive errors are planned portably; IOMSG unchanged on success is planned with a sentinel while condition-message text is never compared. Source accounting only.
